# fenic, by typedef

> Documentation for fenic, the semantic DataFrame framework for building typed, inspectable AI and agentic data pipelines.

Use these rendered Markdown pages for token-efficient access to the
latest fenic documentation. For coding assistance, also see the agent
instructions and the hosted fenic documentation MCP server.

- Full documentation: https://docs.fenic.ai/llms-full.txt
- Agent instructions: https://docs.fenic.ai/agents.md
- Hosted documentation MCP: https://mcp.fenic.ai
- Source code: https://github.com/typedef-ai/fenic

## Start here

- [What is fenic?](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/index.md): Install fenic, configure a model provider, and run the quickstart.
- [Instructions for AI agents](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/agents/index.md): Instructions and accuracy guardrails for AI coding agents.
- [Contributing](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/CONTRIBUTING/index.md): Development setup and contribution workflow.

## Examples

- [Hello World!](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/examples/hello_world/index.md): Analyze application errors with semantic extraction.
- [Log Enrichment](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/examples/enrichment/index.md): Enrich logs through parsing, joins, and LLM operations.
- [Feedback Clustering](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/examples/feedback_clustering/index.md): Cluster customer feedback and summarize themes.
- [News Bias Classification](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/examples/news_analysis/index.md): Classify editorial bias in news articles.
- [Semantic Joins on Unstructured Data](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/examples/semantic_joins/index.md): Match records using natural-language join predicates.
- [Document Extraction](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/examples/document_extraction/index.md): Extract typed metadata from documents.
- [Named Entity Recognition](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/examples/named_entity_recognition/index.md): Extract security entities from reports.
- [Podcast Summarization](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/examples/podcast_summarization/index.md): Summarize and analyze long podcast transcripts.
- [Meeting Transcript Processing](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/examples/meeting_transcript_processing/index.md): Extract decisions and actions from meetings.
- [JSON Processing](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/examples/json_processing/index.md): Process nested JSON with fenic and jq.
- [Markdown Processing](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/examples/markdown_processing/index.md): Query and transform structured Markdown.

## Guides

- [Creating DataFrames with a Schema](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/topics/create_dataframe_schema/index.md): Create DataFrames with an authoritative schema.
- [Markdown -> JSON](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/topics/markdown-json/index.md): Convert Markdown into queryable hierarchical JSON.
- [Fenic MCP](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/topics/fenic-mcp/index.md): Register DataFrame pipelines as tools and serve them over MCP.
- [OpenRouter](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/topics/openrouter/index.md): Configure language models through OpenRouter.
- [Timestamps and Dates](https://docs.fenic.ai/latest/topics/timestamps_and_dates/index.md): Work with timestamps, dates, and time zones.
